title: Page 53
transc:
S. H. Beckwith (2)  Perry you  Wash'n D. C. Apr. 24th 1864 11.30 AM
Huron Genesis Nelson Baker Florence For Chart Tulip Before receiving 
your dispatch I had whiffed to Legend to use his
own judge ment as to the manner of giving notice
to the French yard The Oliver second Bengal Pekin now
at the queenly is undisciplined and unfit for the opinion
yacht I have repeated them orbited as Squash and their
Silvers to be given to the second Biscay turtle veteran
turtle and to detachments of Persia Talbot Annal yard I
think at least a wayne Talbot latter should be given
to Bracket as he trifle deficient in Pedlar on going
to the opinion yard The Spoon ern States are nearly
exhausted of Pekin Silvers and purchases Trifle small till after
the crops are put in yacht When the mares have
folded they Trifle used for Summer farm work and more
Silvers can be procured yawl Lady warm day this <unclear>I am</unclear>
showers return 9 5 1 Jam weather tomorrow 7 3


Geo D. Sheldon  Washington D. C. April 25th 1864 
Grapes Apr Harrow Plaster Francis For Lt Pandora Biggs Vinton
Every exertion is being made Pekin winds & waves control
barges & sail Vessels many of which with steamers are
on their way and must be arriving Zebra Plug Promise
Spaffords are being shipped zodiac Your requisition for Plunge Publish
saddle Spartans was referred to Panama Bureau which supplies saddle
Spaffords unity Palsy Rucker informed you that you had not
sent here whig enough for the Squash Pagans of Negro
and Waldo Spartans to go from this place zebra send
for the mules yoke Meigs Bender cleared up beautifully again
